title: Every inference operations dashboard panel expression, asked of a real Prometheus in nine controlled states
statement: Readings are what the release's own collector returned to an instant query of each committed panel expression at one moment, classified by tools/inference_dashboard/live.py. Every number is an observation of one single-replica release on one host at one moment. None is a measurement of latency, throughput, or capacity. Each screenshot was rendered shortly after its state's capture, not at the same instant, so a figure on a screenshot can differ from the reading: the serving-runtime-scaled-to-zero screenshot shows 17 failed readiness checks where the reading is 13.

states.action: Every workload ready and no inference request sent. One request to a path the API does not serve preceded this capture.
Captured while four concurrent clients were sending successful requests, after the three refused requests and thirty sequential ones below.

traffic.note: Sent while confirming the request shape, before any successful request. All three carried max_tokens, a member outside the request subset the API accepts, and one of them also named a model the release is not configured with. The API counted all three, so they are in every later figure. Their durations were not logged: two were printed at 0.092 s and 0.070 s and the third was sent by hand and not timed.

states.action: Captured after the concurrent traffic finished and the collector had scraped and recorded it.
Twenty requests naming a model this release is not configured with.
The release's serving runtime Deployment scaled to zero replicas, ten valid requests sent, captured once the collector recorded the runtime job as discovering no pod.
The runtime Deployment scaled back to one replica, ready again, and ten valid requests sent.
The API pod deleted by name; captured once its replacement published an identity, while the deleted pod's series were still returned.
Captured once only the replacement API process's identity was returned.
The API Deployment scaled to zero replicas; captured once the collector recorded the platform-api job as discovering no pod and no identity was returned.

directReads.method: Instant queries of the raw counters, sent by hand once the recorded runtime series had caught up with llama-server's own counter; not a panel expression and not a capture.
directReads.note: Every request in the run sent the same 18-token prompt, which is close to the most prompt-cache reuse possible; how far the runtime's input counter falls below the API's depends on that reuse.

directReads.method: An instant query of sum by (le) (inferops_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket) evaluated at the traffic capture's instant, sent by hand after that capture; not a panel expression.
